mapper.select:
SELECT CAST(tx_date AS DATE) AS txDate, SUM(amount) AS totalAmount, COUNT(*) AS txCount FROM tx
tx_date >= CAST(#{from} AS DATE)
AND tx_date < DATEADD('DAY', 1, CAST(#{to} AS DATE))
GROUP BY CAST(tx_date AS DATE) ORDER BY txDate ASC LIMIT #{_pagesize} OFFSET #{_skiprows}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO daily_tx_agg (tx_date, total_amount, tx_count) KEY (tx_date) VALUES (#{txDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{txCount})
mapper.select:
SELECT DATEADD('DAY', 1 - DAYOFMONTH(tx_date), tx_date) AS ymDate, SUM(total_amount) AS totalAmount, SUM(tx_count) AS txCount FROM daily_tx_agg
tx_date >= CAST(#{from} AS DATE)
AND tx_date < DATEADD('DAY', 1, CAST(#{to} AS DATE))
GROUP BY DATEADD('DAY', 1 - DAYOFMONTH(tx_date), tx_date) ORDER BY ymDate ASC LIMIT #{_pagesize} OFFSET #{_skiprows}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO monthly_tx_agg (ym_date, total_amount, tx_count) KEY (ym_date) VALUES (#{ymDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{txCount})
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO user_tx (tx_id, user_id, product_code, amount, tx_date) KEY(tx_id) VALUES (#{txId}, #{userId}, #{productCode}, #{amount}, #{txDate})
mapper.select: SELECT tx_id AS txId, user_id AS userId, product_code AS productCode, amount, tx_date AS txDate FROM user_tx ORDER BY tx_id LIMIT #{_pagesize} OFFSET #{_skiprows}
